## What is VidWud?


VidWud is an AI face-swap product for replacing a face in an image or video. Face swap sits beside talking-photo, image-to-video and presentation tools. Use only media you own or have permission to edit, and obtain explicit consent from every identifiable person.


## What VidWud does well


Browser-based photo and video face swaps inside a larger AI tool hub. Its workflow removes much of the manual masking and compositing required by conventional editing. That convenience does not prove every output is accurate: inspect eyes, teeth, hairlines, skin edges, occlusion, lighting and identity across the full clip.


## VidWud pricing and access


VidWud’s current Terms say some features require payment, subscriptions or credits, with the applicable price shown before purchase. Credit consumption can vary by feature and promotional credits may expire. That makes the live account screen the authoritative source for job cost.


## Privacy, consent and commercial use


VidWud’s privacy policy says uploaded content is typically deleted within seven days, user content is not used for model training unless explicitly disclosed and consented to, and facial data is not used for recognition, authentication, surveillance or profiling.


A commercial-use label does not clear publicity, copyright, trademark or contractual rights. Keep written consent, source licenses and disclosure records. Never use face swap to impersonate, deceive, harass or create intimate imagery without consent.

## How to test VidWud fairly


Use one permitted portrait, one difficult side angle and one short motion clip. Keep resolution, duration and source files constant. Record attempts, processing time, charged credits, watermarks, export resolution and whether the output was usable without manual repair.


Reject outputs with identity drift, unstable jaw or hair boundaries, flicker, incorrect occlusion, changed expression, altered skin tone or artifacts around glasses and hands. Compare cost per accepted output rather than cost per generation.


## Verdict


VidWud has a defensible place for browser-based photo and video face swaps inside a larger ai tool hub. Current purchase price and credit cost appear only in the product or checkout flow. Test one representative job and verify current policies before committing sensitive media or recurring production.
